title: Plague Garden
author: josh-reynolds
description: Lord-Castellant Gardus Steel Soul leads a warrior chamber of the Hallowed Knights into the Garden of Nurgle itself — the festering pocket realm at the heart of the Realm of Life — to rescue a captured Lord-Relictor. What they find in that paradise of rot will test the limits of faith and immortality alike.

title: Black Pyramid
author: josh-reynolds
description: In the aftermath of the Necroquake, the Hallowed Knights venture into Shyish in search of a mysterious black pyramid that may hold the key to understanding Nagash's apocalyptic design. The Realm of Death is no place for the living — but for Sigmar's reforged, it is no place for the dead either.
